title: Steer Agent Output with Agent Control Guidance
dataSources: Agent Control steer decisions and their `steering_context.message`, recorded as control spans
description: Sends guidance back to the agent when a step's output matches a pattern, using a post-stage steer control in Agent Control, so the agent can retry instead of returning the matching output.
value: Some outputs are fixable rather than forbidden, such as an answer that includes an internal hostname. Steering lets the agent correct itself, which users prefer to a flat refusal.
implementation: Decorate the step with `@control(step_name=...)`. Create a control at stage `post` with a condition on `output` and decision steer, carrying a `steering_context.message`. Catch `ControlSteerError` and retry the step with the guidance.
visualization: Control spans on traces, showing steer decisions and the retried step.

references.title: Splunk Agent Observability: Agent Control overview

knownFalsePositives: A retry can match again. Cap the number of retries in the app, and fall back to a refusal when the cap is reached.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites

A Splunk Agent Observability project for the application and one Agent Stream per environment or agent inside it. Do not create a second project for the same application: a second project splits the traces. The agent reads `SPLUNK_AO_PROJECT` and `SPLUNK_AO_AGENT_STREAM` from the environment. SaaS tenants authenticate with `SPLUNK_AO_REALM` and `SPLUNK_AO_O11Y_TOKEN`; on-prem tenants with `SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY` plus `SPLUNK_AO_CONSOLE_URL`. Install the SDK with `pip install splunk-ao` (`pip install "splunk-ao[langchain]"` for the LangChain callback). Agent Control is a separate server and a separate install (`agent-control-sdk`, plus `agent-control-evaluators`; one of those packages is still named `agent-control-evaluator-galileo`, the platform's old name).

Step 1 — Instrument the agent

The app calls `agent_control.init` and decorates the step with `@control(step_name=...)`. There are two ways to bind a control, and a tenant uses one of them. The Splunk Agent Observability docs pass the resolved `agent_stream_id` (not the stream name) as `target_id` and attach the control to the stream in the console. The SDK path calls `init(agent_name=...)`, creates a policy, adds the control to it, and assigns the policy to that agent name. If the repo already has an example, follow it. Run the decorated step inside an open trace so the control span lands on that trace.

Step 2 — Configure in Splunk Agent Observability

A control has a scope (step type `llm` or `tool`, step name, and stage `pre` or `post`), a condition (a selector path such as `input` or `output` plus a check from the control server's catalog: regex, list, JSON, SQL, Luna-2 or custom), and an action. Actions, strictest first: deny, steer, observe; deny wins over steer over observe. Regex patterns are RE2, so there is no lookahead. Write the pattern as the thing to catch: the engine has no "unless".

Step 3 — Validate

Trigger the pattern on a test stream and confirm the app receives `ControlSteerError` with the guidance and the retry succeeds. This use case was written from the Splunk Agent Observability documentation without access to a tenant, so it ships as a draft. Confirm each step in the Splunk Agent Observability console before promoting it.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Count steer decisions per week from the traces and tighten prompts where the same steer keeps firing.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

Steer never fires: a deny control on the same step also matched, and deny wins. Endless retries: add a retry cap in the app.
grandmaExplanation: If the assistant's answer includes something it should not say, a guard hands it a note explaining what to fix, and it tries again.

productArtifacts.title: Post-stage steer control on the answer step
productArtifacts.body:
Scope: step_types=[llm], step_names=[answer], stages=[post]
Condition: selector.path=output; check=regex; pattern written as the text to catch (RE2)
Action: decision=steer; steering_context.message="Remove internal hostnames and answer again."
Binding: attach to the Agent Stream in the console (target_id = agent_stream_id), or the policy path (init(agent_name=...), create_control, create_policy, add_control_to_policy, assign_policy_to_agent)
Notes: Deny wins over steer when both match.
